dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: Nara friend, want another story of Aranara? Aravinay knows many. You have to exchange new stories for them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell the story of the adventure with Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: What story is Nara friend bringing? Will Nara friend surprise the ancient tree, and make the dewdrops fall?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About stories of the past...

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: Many stories of the past, started to be told, only after Nara Varuna arrived at Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: New Nara friend, golden as Nara Varuna. Must have lots of new stories.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the staff in your hand...

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: Aravinay's staff is a precious staff that has heard many stories.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: The pattern on the staff grows continuously, like the annual rings of a tree. The more stories it hears, the stronger the staff becomes.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: One day, it will grow into a big tree full of stories.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: If Nara friend were Aranara, you would surely understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: Yes. Aravinay understands. You are a Nara full of stories. If you have good stories, let's share.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} brought many new stories. Aravinay's stories are finished. New stories still continue.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell the story of the adventure with Aranara.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: So this is the story of Arama... The story of the new Ashvattha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the new story...

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Arama's new story is as plump as the Bijas.

dialogues.speaker: Aravinay
dialogues.text: No matter how many times the sun rises again, your story will not be forgotten. Vana will always remember you.
